sentences: Robust linear regression must estimate a predictor despite adversarially corrupted observations.
This source studies Gaussian covariates with unknown covariance and tracks how the covariance condition number interacts with the corruption rate.
The selected question asks for an efficient algorithm matching a proposed subquadratic sample scale while obtaining nontrivial error in the less favorable conditioning regime.
Statistical-query and low-degree lower bounds provide evidence about the tradeoff but do not supply the missing general algorithm.
A matching construction would identify how far efficient robust estimation can improve on a trivial predictor when corruption and ill-conditioning reinforce each other.
working_summary.note: The title flattens the sample-bound formula and its condition-number regime; the description uses the original regression setting without promoting the truncated formula to a complete theorem.
